content: I thought people here might be interested in a talk on Feb. 25 about using Lean to teach proof writing. The flyer for the talk has more information, including a zoom link.
Is there a recording of the talk?

The host for the talk was Joshua Sasmor (sasmor@setonhill.edu). He says that the talk was recorded, but the speaker requested that the recording not be posted online. You could contact him and see if he can share the recording with you.
Hey Dan, I'm new to Lean and would appreciate access as well if possible, this hits writing + Lean which would be useful to me.
@Carlisia Campos I don't have access to the recording. You should contact Joshua Sasmor (sasmor@setonhill.edu), who hosted the talk.

I am wondering about the pedagogical aspect: Do you think this approach is suitable for teaching Lean to students ?
